name: published_date
description: Print publication date of the Best Sellers list (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: list_name_encoded
description: URL-safe list identifier (e.g., hardcover-fiction)

name: list_display_name
description: Human-readable list name (e.g., Hardcover Fiction)

name: list_updated
description: How often the list is updated (WEEKLY or MONTHLY)

name: rank
description: Rank on the list for this published_date

name: rank_last_week
description: Rank on the list in the previous publication (0 if new)

name: weeks_on_list
description: Number of weeks the book has appeared on this list

name: asterisk
description: 1 if sales are barely distinguishable from those of the book above it

name: dagger
description: 1 if some retailers reported receiving bulk orders

name: primary_isbn13
description: ISBN-13 identifier for the book (primary edition)

name: title
description: Book title

name: author
description: Book author

name: contributor
description: Full contributor string (e.g., 'by Emily Henry')

name: contributor_note
description: Additional contributor information (illustrator, translator, etc.)

name: publisher
description: Publisher name

name: description
description: Short editorial description of the book

name: book_image
description: URL to the book cover image

name: amazon_product_url
description: Affiliate Amazon product URL

name: age_group
description: Target age group (used for children's lists)

name: book_review_link
description: Link to NYT book review (if any)

name: sunday_review_link
description: Link to NYT Sunday book review (if any)
